holidays.name: National Bavarian Cream Pie Day
holidays.description: A day to celebrate the silky, custard-filled dessert that pairs a rich Bavarian cream filling with a flaky pie crust. Bakers and dessert lovers are encouraged to indulge in a slice, or two, or the whole pie.
holidays.origin: Like many American food holidays, it is an unofficial observance popularized by food-day calendars and social media. Bavarian cream itself traces back to 19th-century European pastry kitchens, with French chefs like Marie-Antoine Carême credited with refining it.
holidays.funFact: Despite its name, Bavarian cream (crème bavaroise) is thought to have been perfected by French chefs, not Bavarians. It is stabilized with gelatin, which gives it a mousse-like texture.

holidays.name: Pins and Needles Day
holidays.description: A day dedicated to the humble tools of sewing and the prickly sensation of limbs waking up. Crafters celebrate by mending, stitching, and sewing, while everyone else tries not to sit on their foot.
holidays.origin: It is an unofficial observance listed in quirky-holiday calendars, said to honor sewing and the needlework traditions that have been part of households for centuries.
holidays.funFact: The oldest known sewing needles, made of bone, are roughly 50,000 years old and were found in a Siberian cave, which means people have been poking themselves with needles for a very long time.

holidays.name: Bavarian Cream Pie Day's Rival: Cyber Monday Recovery Day (Unofficial)
holidays.description: An unofficial observance of the post-Thanksgiving shopping frenzy, when many people are recovering from food comas, doorbusters, and way too many browser tabs full of discounted gadgets.
holidays.origin: It grew out of the American tradition of Black Friday and Cyber Monday shopping, which falls in the days after Thanksgiving. The term Cyber Monday was coined in 2005 by the National Retail Federation's Shop.org.
holidays.funFact: The term Black Friday was originally used by Philadelphia police in the 1960s to describe the chaotic crowds of shoppers and tourists that flooded the city after Thanksgiving.

holidays.name: Jimi Hendrix Birthday Celebration
holidays.description: Fans of rock and roll mark the birthday of the legendary guitarist who famously played a right-handed guitar upside down and set one on fire at Monterey Pop in 1967. Celebrate by cranking up some Purple Haze.
holidays.origin: Jimi Hendrix was born on November 27, 1942, in Seattle, Washington. Fans and music lovers have celebrated his birthday as an informal tribute to his revolutionary guitar style.
holidays.funFact: Hendrix's entire mainstream career lasted only about four years, yet he is widely considered one of the greatest electric guitarists of all time.
